name: STICKEE | Cherry Smash | Hybrid | Live Resin Concentrate | 1G
description: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ " . . .Cherry Smash tastes like the Kool-Aid Man finally hit the gym." CHERRY SMASH. It’s sweet, it’s tart, it’s basically the lovechild of a science experiment and a fruit fight. We froze the flower at stupidly cold temperatures, extracted every terpene like it was the last drop of hot sauce, and packed it into 1G of live resin so flavorful it should come with a warning label: ‘May cause happiness and really weird text messages.’ Why should you buy it? Because life’s too short for boring weed and frankly, you deserve something that slaps as hard as this.
